title: Quietly Rich Venezuelan Plantain Casserole
description: A fatty and creamy weeknight Venezuelan dish featuring a fruit mix, cure, and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, served in a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel the plantains and slice them into 1-inch rounds.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and cook the plantains until they are golden brown.
In a large bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, eggs, heavy cream, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the cooked plantains to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the sugar mixture.
Transfer the plantain mixture to a bamboo tray and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
